description: This file defines the core models and functions for RetinaNet object detection, including submodels for classification and regression, feature pyramid creation, and the main RetinaNet model assembly with bounding box prediction and NMS layers.

methods.name: default_classification_model
methods.description: Creates the default classification submodel for RetinaNet, predicting class scores for each anchor.

methods.name: default_regression_model
methods.description: Creates the default regression submodel for RetinaNet, predicting bounding box regressions for each anchor.

methods.name: __create_pyramid_features
methods.description: Constructs the feature pyramid layers (P3-P7) on top of backbone features for use in RetinaNet.

methods.name: default_submodels
methods.description: Returns the default set of submodels (regression and classification) for object detection.

methods.name: __build_model_pyramid
methods.description: Applies a submodel to each level of the feature pyramid and concatenates the results.

methods.name: __build_pyramid
methods.description: Applies all submodels to each level of the feature pyramid.

methods.name: __build_anchors
methods.description: Generates anchor boxes for each feature map level based on anchor parameters.

methods.name: retinanet
methods.description: Constructs the main RetinaNet model with feature pyramid, anchor generation, and submodels for classification and regression.

methods.name: retinanet_bbox
methods.description: Extends RetinaNet with bounding box prediction, applying regression to anchors, clipping boxes, and performing NMS to produce final detections.
